thought.text: Two stray vite processes remain from my server test. Let me clean them up.

reasoning_content:

- node 24.18.0 + npm 11.16.0

- static checks pass, 5147 tests pass, build succeeds, dev server serves the app

Actually `timeout 60 mise exec -- npm start` — when the timeout fires, it should kill the mise exec process. But maybe the vite child process survived as an orphan. Let me clean these up to leave a clean state.
